name: showcase
description: Every plugin component in one gallery: each view node, field, span and button style, plus flags, toasts, context, session environment, secrets, events, host commands, a wake source and its own thread and terminal. For plugin authors and for testing the host.

commands.name: ping
commands.title: Ping Showcase
commands.description: Answer pong with a running count: a command with no args and no confirm.

commands.name: boom
commands.title: Blow Up Something
commands.description: Pretend to destroy something: a command that asks first, with an arg in its confirm text. Nothing is deleted.
commands.confirm: Blow up {what}? Nothing is really deleted.

commands.name: flag
commands.title: Flag Thread
commands.description: Raise an attention or error flag on a thread, or clear it (level none).

args.name: level
args.description: attention, error, or none to clear

args.name: reason
args.description: The flag's reason (one line, up to 80 characters)

args.name: until-seen
args.description: Clear it when the thread is opened

commands.name: gate
commands.title: Turn Showcase Gate On or Off
commands.description: Set or remove the showcase.on fact for a thread (or everywhere); the Gated tab exists only where it is true.

commands.name: fire-tick
commands.title: Fire Showcase Tick Now
commands.description: Fire the tick wake source now: wake the threads subscribed to it (each armed every, or --every).

args.name: every
args.description: Only the subscriptions with this every (default: each one armed)

wakes.name: tick
wakes.title: Tick
wakes.description: Fires every <every> while a thread is subscribed (once without --repeat), and when fired by hand (Fire tick, fire-tick); the payload has the tick count. A demo of wake sources.
